b2-27-01.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Accident
b2-27-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks why the city changed its traffic rules last month. They changed the rules because of an accident.
b2-27-01.prompt: Tell Meg why the city changed the traffic rules.
cues: Say what set the change off
b2-27-01.target: A raíz de un accidente, la ciudad cambió las normas de tráfico.
b2-27-01.english: Following an accident, the city changed its traffic rules.
b2-27-01.canDo: I can use *a raíz de* for an event that sets something off.

b2-27-02.title: Communicative Challenge: According to the Report
b2-27-02.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks if more tourists come to the city this year. A report says that the number went up.
b2-27-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what the report says about the tourists.
cues: Name the source of the information
Say what has changed this year
b2-27-02.target: De acuerdo con el informe, el número de turistas subió este año.
b2-27-02.english: According to the report, the number of tourists rose this year.
b2-27-02.canDo: I can use *de acuerdo con* and *según* to name a source.

b2-27-03.title: Communicative Challenge: At What Cost?
b2-27-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks why two neighbours stopped arguing. They both gave way for the sake of peace.
b2-27-03.prompt: Tell Meg why the two neighbours stopped arguing.
cues: Say what they did it for
b2-27-03.target: Los dos vecinos cedieron en aras de la paz.
b2-27-03.english: The two neighbours gave way for the sake of peace.
b2-27-03.canDo: I can use *en aras de* for the aim someone gives something up for.

b2-27-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Timetable
b2-27-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you think of the new timetable. You think it is better than the old one.
b2-27-04.prompt: Give Carlos your opinion of the new timetable.
cues: Make clear that this is your opinion
Compare it with the old timetable
b2-27-04.target: A mi juicio, el nuevo horario es mejor que el anterior.
b2-27-04.english: In my opinion, the new timetable is better than the old one.
b2-27-04.canDo: I can use *a juicio de* to give someone's opinion.

b2-27-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is the Book About?
b2-27-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what a book is about. It is about two brothers and a problem between them.
b2-27-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what the book is about.
cues: Say what the book is about
Say who the problem is between
b2-27-05.target: Se trata de un problema entre dos hermanos.
b2-27-05.english: It is about a problem between two brothers.
b2-27-05.canDo: I can use *consistir en*, *derivar en*, *tratarse de* and *abogar por* with the right preposition.

b2-27-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Snakes' Congress
b2-27-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about the story by Horacio Quiroga that you read. The snakes held a congress, and they chose the culebra Ñacaniná to go to the Casa and see what the men were doing.
b2-27-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what the snakes did in the story.
cues: Say who went to the Casa
b2-27-consolidation.target: Las serpientes hicieron un congreso y enviaron a la Ñacaniná a la Casa.
b2-27-consolidation.english: The snakes held a congress and sent the Ñacaniná to the Casa.
b2-27-consolidation.canDo: I can read a short retelling of the start of Horacio Quiroga's Anaconda.
